summary: Iteration 54 - PDF Invoice Generation, Financial KPIs, Guest Profile Timeline. All 23 backend tests passed (100%). Frontend verified with all 6 Financial KPI cards visible on Dashboard Home and PDF download button working on Invoices tab.
critical_code_review_comments: PDF Invoice Generation fully implemented with reportlab library
GET /api/accounting/invoices/{invoice_id}/pdf returns StreamingResponse with application/pdf content type
PDF contains: hotel name, invoice number, counterparty, line items with VAT, subtotal, VAT amount, total, balance due
Content-Disposition header set for download with filename like INV-00003.pdf
Financial KPIs endpoint calculates RevPAR (revenue/available room-nights) and ADR (revenue/room-nights-sold)

GET /api/dashboard/financial-kpis/{property_id} returns: month, adr, revpar, occupancy, month_revenue, month_expenses, month_profit, nps_score, nps_responses, ar_outstanding, total_rooms, room_nights_sold, month_bookings
Guest Timeline aggregates from bookings, conversations, survey_responses, reviews, and payments collections
GET /api/guests/timeline/{guest_email} returns: guest_email, profile, timeline (sorted by date desc), counts
Timeline items have: type, date, title, subtitle, detail, icon, color
Frontend Dashboard Home shows 6 Financial KPI cards: RevPAR, ADR, Revenue (MTD), Net Profit (MTD), NPS Score, AR Outstanding
Frontend Invoices tab has PDF download button for each invoice linking to /api/accounting/invoices/{id}/pdf
All existing dashboard features still work: Today's Snapshot, Quick Actions, Notifications, GSS widget
All existing accounting features still work: 19 tabs including Bank Recon
seed_data_creation: Test invoice created with TEST_PDF_Guest counterparty during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 54 completed full testing of PDF Invoice Generation, Financial KPIs, and Guest Timeline features. PDF endpoint uses reportlab library and returns StreamingResponse. Financial KPIs are displayed on Dashboard Home between Quick Actions and Action Required panel. Guest Timeline aggregates activity from 5 collections (bookings, conversations, survey_responses, reviews, payments). Use property_id 'aldgate-flats' for testing. All 19 accounting tabs still work.
